title: Mechanical Arm Control
source_reference: 大作业题库json/大作业题库.json, hard[4]
requirements: Implement a mechanical-arm control function block with mutually exclusive manual, single-step, single-cycle, and continuous modes. Exactly one mode is selected during a test. The arm has down, grip, up, right, down, release, up, and left as its automatic handling sequence, starting from the top-left position. In manual mode, each button commands only its matching action and only while the corresponding limit switch is not active. In single-step mode, each rising edge of Start permits the next automatic action; stop that action when its matching completion limit is reached, then wait for another Start rising edge. In single-cycle mode, one Start rising edge runs the entire automatic sequence and stops after returning to the top-left position. In continuous mode, one Start rising edge begins repeated automatic cycles. GripLimitSwitch and ReleaseLimitSwitch are the completion feedback for grip and release. EmergencyStop is active-low: when FALSE, immediately set all six action outputs to FALSE and pause without advancing the current automatic step; when it returns TRUE, the current step resumes. Never command opposing directions at the same time.

interface.name: EmergencyStop
interface.description: FALSE means emergency stop is active; TRUE permits operation
